requirement_text: Where a SORP applies to the entity (as determined by the scope conditions set out in the SORP itself), provide the disclosures required by paragraph 6 of FRS 100 Application of Financial Reporting Requirements.

A qualifying entity that is a financial institution may take advantage of the disclosure exemptions in paragraph 1.12 in its individual financial statements, except that it must not use the exemptions from Section 11 Basic Financial Instruments and Section 12 Other Financial Instruments Issues.
trigger_condition: is_qualifying_entity == true and is_financial_institution == true and is_individual_financial_statements == true

requirement_text: Disclose the average number of persons employed by the entity in the reporting period.

State the accounting policies adopted in determining the amounts included in respect of items shown in the statement of financial position and in determining profit or loss, including policies on depreciation and impairment of assets.
For the aggregate of all items shown under 'creditors' in the small entity's statement of financial position, state the aggregate of the amounts specified in the sub-paragraphs of paragraph 1AC.27.

For each line item shown under creditors in the statement of financial position, disclose the aggregate amount of debts included in that item in respect of which any security has been given by the small entity, together with an indication of the nature and form of any such security.
Disclose the total amount of any financial commitments, guarantees and contingencies not included in the balance sheet.
Disclose in the notes details of any advances and credits granted by the entity to its directors, and any guarantees of any kind entered into by the entity on behalf of its directors.
The financial statements must state the presentation currency.
The financial statements must state the level of rounding, if any, used in presenting amounts in the financial statements.

Disclose in the notes, explanatory material, or supplementary schedules any item that fails to meet recognition criteria but whose knowledge is relevant to users' evaluation of financial position, performance, and changes in financial position.
Present notes in a systematic manner, as far as practicable, with each item in the primary statements cross-referenced to related note information
Provide additional disclosures beyond those specified in Section 1A where necessary to give a true and fair view, as required by paragraph 1A.5.
As a minimum, where relevant to its transactions, other events and conditions, a small entity reporting in the UK shall provide the disclosures set out in Appendix C to Section 1A.

Where an entity departed from a requirement of FRS 102 or applicable legislation in a prior period and that departure affects amounts recognised in the current period, disclose the information required by paragraph 3.5(c).

Disclose material uncertainties related to events or conditions that cast significant doubt upon the entity's ability to continue as a going concern, when management is aware of such uncertainties in making its going concern assessment.

When financial statements are not prepared on a going concern basis, disclose that fact, the basis on which the financial statements are prepared, and the reason why the entity is not regarded as a going concern.

Disclose material uncertainties related to events or conditions that cast significant doubt upon the entity's ability to continue as a going concern, when management is aware of those uncertainties in making its assessment.
Disclose the fact that the financial statements are not prepared on a going concern basis, the basis on which they were prepared, and the reason why the entity is not regarded as a going concern.

A small entity choosing to apply paragraph 1B(1) of Schedule 1 to the Small Companies Regulations and adapt one of the balance sheet formats shall disclose, either in the statement of financial position or in the notes, the following sub-classifications of the line items presented (as enumerated in the sub-paragraphs of 1AA.4).

When a small entity chooses to apply paragraph 1B(2) of Schedule 1 to the Small Companies Regulations and adapt a profit and loss account format, it shall include as a minimum in its income statement line items presenting the amounts required by FRS 102 paragraph 1AB.3 (the specific minimum line items are enumerated in sub-paragraphs of 1AB.3 not reproduced in the verbatim extract above; the reviewer should confirm each required line item is present in the income statement).
Present comparative information in respect of the preceding period for all amounts presented in the current period's financial statements, except when FRS 102 permits or requires otherwise.
Include comparative information for narrative and descriptive information when it is relevant to an understanding of the current period's financial statements.
Include comparative information for narrative and descriptive information when it is relevant to an understanding of the current period's financial statements.
Present separately each material class of similar items; also present separately items of dissimilar nature or function unless they are immaterial.
Provide, as a minimum, all disclosures set out in Appendix 1AC that are relevant to the entity's transactions, other events and conditions.

Where development costs are shown or included as an asset and the amount is not treated as a realised loss because there are special circumstances justifying this, a note to the financial statements must state: (a) the reasons for showing development costs as an asset, and (b) that the amount is not treated as a realised loss.
trigger_condition: applies_section_1A == true AND (has_capitalised_development_costs == true AND development_costs_not_treated_as_realised_loss_special_circumstances == true)

requirement_text: Disclose in a note the period over which intangible assets are being written off and the reasons for choosing that period, where in exceptional cases the useful life of those intangible assets cannot be reliably estimated.
A complete set of financial statements shall include a statement of changes in equity for the reporting period.

A complete set of financial statements shall include all of the required components as listed in paragraph 3.17 (e.g. a statement of financial position, a statement of comprehensive income or equivalent, a cash flow statement, a statement of changes in equity, and notes).

The financial statements shall include a statement of changes in equity for the period, unless the entity presents a statement of income and retained earnings in place of both the income statement and statement of changes in equity.

Where there is a change in the presentation of the statement of financial position or income statement, disclose in a note to the financial statements (in which the new presentation is first used): particulars of the change and the reasons for the change.

Where a corresponding amount for the immediately preceding reporting period is not comparable with the current period amount and that corresponding amount has been adjusted, disclose in a note (i) the particulars of the non-comparability and (ii) the particulars of any adjustment made to the corresponding amount.
trigger_condition: applies_section_1A == true AND (has_non_comparable_corresponding_amount == true AND has_non_comparable_corresponding_amount == true)

requirement_text: Any alternative titles used for the financial statements must not be misleading.
Clearly identify each financial statement and the notes, and distinguish them from other information in the same document
Display the information required by paragraph 3.23 prominently, and repeat it when necessary for an understanding of the information presented

The financial statements shall include a statement of cash flows for the period, unless the entity is a qualifying entity that has taken the exemption from preparing a cash flow statement under Section 7.

Clearly identify each financial statement and the notes and distinguish them from other information in the same document; and display the following information prominently and repeat it when necessary for an understanding of the information presented (specific items listed in sub-paragraphs of 3.23).
Where any amount relating to a preceding reporting period is included in any item in the income statement, state the effect of that amount.

When adapting a Schedule 1 balance sheet format under paragraph 1A(1) of the Regulations, include as a minimum in the statement of financial position line items that present each of the required items specified in FRS 102 paragraph 4.2A, distinguishing between those items that are current and those that are non-current.

Disclose in the notes: (a) particulars of the departure from company law accounting principles, (b) the reasons for it, and (c) its effect, whenever a small entity departs from any of the principles set out in company law in preparing its financial statements.

Present current and non-current assets, and current and non-current liabilities, as separate classifications in the statement of financial position to distinguish between current and non-current items.

Present current and non-current assets, and current and non-current liabilities, as separate classifications in the statement of financial position to distinguish between current and non-current items.
Present additional line items, headings and subtotals in the statement of financial position when such presentation is relevant to an understanding of the entity's financial position.

Where the amount of debtors due after more than one year is so material in the context of total net current assets that, in the absence of disclosure on the face of the statement of financial position, readers may misinterpret the financial statements, disclose that amount on the face of the statement of financial position within current assets. In most cases disclosure in the notes will be sufficient; face-of-SoFP disclosure is required only where note disclosure alone would leave readers likely to misinterpret the financial statements.
trigger_condition: has_debtors_due_after_one_year == true AND debtors_after_one_year_material_to_net_current_assets == true AND applies_schedule1_paragraph_1A1 == false

requirement_text: For an entity with share capital, disclose the following either in the statement of financial position or in the notes: (a) number of shares authorised; (b) number of shares issued and fully paid, and issued but not fully paid; (c) par value per share, or that shares have no par value; (d) a reconciliation of shares outstanding at the beginning and end of the period; (e) rights, preferences and restrictions attaching to each class of shares; (f) shares held by the entity itself or by subsidiaries or associates; and (g) shares reserved for issue under options or contracts.

An entity without share capital shall disclose information equivalent to paragraph 4.12(a), showing changes during the period in each category of equity, and the rights, preferences and restrictions attaching to each category of equity.

An entity without share capital shall disclose (a) information equivalent to paragraph 4.12(a) showing changes during the period in each category of equity, and (b) the rights, preferences and restrictions attaching to each category of equity.

Disclose the information specified in paragraph 4.14 (the defined list of required disclosures) when at the reporting date the entity has a binding sale agreement for a major disposal of assets or a disposal group.

Present total comprehensive income for the reporting period in one or two statements. Where the entity meets the specified conditions and chooses to do so, it may instead present a statement of income and retained earnings in accordance with Section 6.

Where an asset or liability relates to more than one item in the statement of financial position, disclose the relationship of that asset or liability to each relevant item, either under those items or in the notes to the financial statements.
For each item shown under the general item 'fixed assets' in the small entity's statement of financial position, the information required by the sub-paragraphs of 1AC.12 must be given.
Include in the statement of comprehensive income line items presenting the required amounts for the period, as enumerated in paragraph 5.5A

Additional line items, amended descriptions or reordering of items in the income statement are only permitted when necessary to explain the elements of financial performance, and the information presented must be at least equivalent to that required by the applicable profit and loss account format had it not been adapted.

Present as separate line items in the statement of comprehensive income the allocation of profit or loss and other comprehensive income attributable to: (a) non-controlling interests; and (b) owners of the parent entity

For each item within paragraph 1AC.12, disclose the additional information required by paragraph 1AC.13 (the paragraph introduces sub-item disclosures in respect of each 1AC.12 item; the full sub-item content is set out in sub-paragraphs of 1AC.13 not reproduced here).
Where fixed assets are measured at revalued amounts, disclose in the accounting policies note the items affected and the basis of valuation adopted for each such item.
trigger_condition: applies_section_1A == true AND (has_revalued_fixed_assets == true or ppe_at_revalued_amounts == true or intangibles_at_revalued_amounts == true)

requirement_text: Where fixed assets (other than listed investments) are included at a revalued amount, disclose: (a) the years in which the assets were severally valued and the several values, and (b) in the case of assets valued during the financial year, the names of the persons who valued them or particulars of their qualifications, and the bases of valuation used.
For each item in the statement of financial position measured at a revalued amount, disclose in a note the comparable amounts determined under the historical cost accounting rules.
If profit or loss is presented in an income statement, present the information required by paragraph 5.6(a) in that statement.

The statement of comprehensive income shall begin with profit or loss as its first line and shall display, as a minimum, line items that present the amounts in paragraphs 5.5A and 5.6(b) for the period.

The statement of comprehensive income shall begin with profit or loss as its first line and shall display, as a minimum, line items presenting the amounts described in paragraphs 5.5A and 5.6(b) for the period.
Where fixed assets are measured at revalued amounts, the following information must be given in tabular form (as required by the sub-paragraphs of 1AC.17).

Disclose on the face of the income statement (or statement of comprehensive income if presented) an amount comprising the total of [the items required by paragraph 5.7E — paragraph text as supplied is truncated and the specific sub-items cannot be determined from the verbatim text provided]
Re-present the paragraph 5.7E disclosures for all prior periods presented so that those disclosures relate to all operations discontinued by the end of the latest reporting period presented.

Present additional line items, headings and subtotals in the statement of comprehensive income (and in the income statement, if presented) when such presentation is relevant to an understanding of the entity's financial performance.
Disclose in a note the treatment for taxation purposes of amounts credited or debited to the revaluation reserve.

If operating profit is disclosed, items clearly related to operations (such as inventory write-downs, profits or losses on the sale of property, plant and equipment, investment property and intangible assets, and restructuring and relocation expenses) shall not be excluded from operating profit merely because they occur irregularly, infrequently or are unusual in amount; nor shall items be excluded on the grounds that they do not involve cash flows (such as depreciation and amortisation expenses).
If operating profit is disclosed, profits or losses on the disposal of a discontinued operation shall be excluded from operating profit.

Disclose the fact that interest has been included in determining the cost of an asset, and the amount of interest so included, in a note to the financial statements where a policy of capitalising borrowing costs is adopted.

If provisions for impairment of fixed assets (including fixed asset investments) are not shown separately in the income statement, they must be disclosed separately in a note to the financial statements.
trigger_condition: applies_section_1A == true AND (has_impaired_assets == true AND impairment_shown_separately_in_income_statement == false)

requirement_text: Disclose (either separately or in aggregate, in a note to the financial statements if not shown separately in the income statement) any provisions for impairment of fixed assets that are reversed because the reasons for which they were made have ceased to apply.

For each class of derivatives measured in accordance with the fair value accounting rules, disclose the extent and nature of the instruments, including significant terms and conditions that may affect the amount, timing and certainty of future cash flows.

Where an amount is transferred to or from the fair value reserve during the reporting period, disclose in tabular form: (a) the amount of the fair value reserve at the beginning of the period; (b) the amount transferred to or from the fair value reserve during the period; (c) the source and application of the amounts so transferred; and (d) the amount of the fair value reserve at the end of the period.

Where valuable security has been given by the small entity in respect of any commitments, guarantees or contingencies (as described in paragraph 1AC.29), disclose an indication of the nature and form of that security.
trigger_condition: applies_section_1A == true AND (has_off_balance_sheet_financial_commitments_guarantees_or_contingencies == true AND has_valuable_security_given == true)

requirement_text: Disclose in the notes the nature and business purpose of off-balance-sheet arrangements to the extent necessary for enabling the financial position of the entity to be assessed, where in the reporting period the entity is or has been party to arrangements not reflected in its statement of financial position and the risks or benefits arising from those arrangements are material at the reporting date.
trigger_condition: applies_section_1A == true AND (has_off_balance_sheet_financial_commitments_guarantees_or_contingencies == true AND off_balance_sheet_arrangements_risks_or_benefits_material_at_reporting_date == true)

requirement_text: Present in the statement of income and retained earnings the items required by paragraph 6.5 in addition to the information required by Section 5.
Disclose the amount and nature of any individual items of income or expense that are of exceptional size or incidence.

Disclose particulars of material transactions the small entity has entered into that have not been concluded under normal market conditions with [counterparties as specified in the continuation of paragraph 1AC.35, not reproduced in the supplied extract].

Where Arabic-numbered line items in any of the formats have been combined, disclose the individual amounts of those combined items in a note to the financial statements, unless the individual items are not material.
Disclose the nature and financial effect of each material event arising after the reporting date that is not reflected in the income statement or statement of financial position.

Present cash flows from operating activities using either the direct method (showing major classes of gross cash receipts and payments) or the indirect method (adjusting profit or loss for non-cash items and working capital changes).
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (NOT is_qualifying_entity OR (is_qualifying_entity AND NOT uses_consolidation_exemption))

requirement_text: Under the indirect method, present a reconciliation determining the net cash flow from operating activities by adjusting a measure of profit or loss disclosed in the statement of comprehensive income (or separate income statement if presented) for the effects of the items specified in paragraph 7.8.
Under the direct method, present net cash flow from operating activities by disclosing major classes of gross cash receipts and gross cash payments.
Present separately, and classify as investing activities, the aggregate cash flows arising from acquisitions and from disposals of subsidiaries or other business units.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (has_acquisition_of_subsidiary_or_business_unit == true OR has_disposal_of_subsidiary_or_business_unit == true)

requirement_text: Disclose an analysis of changes in net debt from the beginning to the end of the reporting period, showing changes resulting from the categories specified in paragraph 7.22.

Present notes to the financial statements providing narrative descriptions or disaggregations of items in the primary statements and information about items that do not qualify for recognition in those statements.
Present separately, and classify as investing activities, the aggregate cash flows arising from acquisitions and from disposals of subsidiaries or other business units.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (has_acquisition_of_subsidiary_or_business_unit == true OR has_disposal_of_subsidiary_or_business_unit == true)

requirement_text: Remeasure cash and cash equivalents held in a foreign currency at period-end exchange rates, and present the resulting unrealised gain or loss separately from cash flows from operating, investing and financing activities in the statement of cash flows.

Disclose in the notes the key assumptions concerning the future and other key sources of estimation uncertainty at the reporting date that have a significant risk of causing a material adjustment to the carrying amounts of assets and liabilities within the next financial year, including details of those assets and liabilities (note: paragraph 8.7 continues with enumerated sub-items specifying what 'details' must include, which should be checked against the full paragraph text)
Disclose the total amount of taxes paid when tax cash flows are allocated over more than one class of activity.
Disclose the total amount of taxes paid when tax cash flows are allocated over more than one class of activity.
Disclose the total amount of taxes paid when tax cash flows are allocated over more than one class of activity.

Classify interest paid as either an operating cash flow or a financing cash flow, and classify interest and dividends received as either operating cash flows or investing cash flows, selecting from the two permitted alternatives described in paragraph 7.15.
Disclose the method used to account for investments in associates (cost model, equity method, or fair value model)

Classify dividends paid either as a financing cash flow or as a component of cash flows from operating activities; confirm that one of these two permitted treatments has been adopted and that no other classification has been used.
Disclose non-cash investing and financing transactions elsewhere in the financial statements in a way that provides all relevant information about those activities
Disclose non-cash investing and financing transactions elsewhere in the financial statements in a way that provides all relevant information about those activities
Present a reconciliation of the cash and cash equivalents amounts in the statement of cash flows to the equivalent items in the statement of financial position.

Present a reconciliation of the amounts of cash and cash equivalents in the statement of cash flows to the equivalent items in the statement of financial position, unless those amounts are identical in amount and description.

Attribute profit or loss and each component of other comprehensive income to owners of the parent and to non-controlling interest; total comprehensive income must be so attributed even if this results in non-controlling interest having a deficit balance.

Attribute profit or loss and each component of other comprehensive income to owners of the parent and to non-controlling interest separately; and attribute total comprehensive income to owners of the parent and to non-controlling interest separately, even where this results in a deficit balance for non-controlling interest

Make the disclosures required by paragraph 9.23 in consolidated financial statements (the specific sub-paragraphs of 9.23 follow; this row captures the overarching 'shall' obligation that consolidated statements include those disclosures)

When a parent prepares separate financial statements, disclose the specific items required by paragraph 9.27 (including: that these are separate financial statements; the name of the entity producing publicly available consolidated or individual financial statements covering the entity; where those statements are obtainable; and the methods used to account for investments in subsidiaries, associates and jointly controlled entities)
Disclose, together with a commentary by management, the amount of significant cash and cash equivalent balances held by the entity that are not available for use by the entity.
Do not recognise a gain or loss on an exchange transaction where the transaction is artificial or lacks substance such that a gain or loss could not be justified.
Where a gain or loss on an exchange transaction is not recognised because the transaction is artificial or lacks substance, explain the circumstances in the notes.
Explain the circumstances where a gain or loss on an exchange transaction has not been recognised because the transaction is artificial or has no substance.
Disclose sufficient information in the notes to enable users to understand the significance of the intermediary and the arrangement in the context of the sponsoring entity's financial statements.

Disclose the nature of any change in an accounting estimate and the effect of the change on assets, liabilities, income and expense for the current period. Where it is practicable to estimate the effect of the change in one or more future periods, disclose those estimates.
Disclose the nature of any change in accounting estimate and the effect of the change on assets, liabilities, income and expense for the current period.
If practicable, disclose the estimated effect of the change in accounting estimate on one or more future periods.

To the extent practicable, correct a material prior period error retrospectively in the first financial statements authorised for issue after its discovery (by restating the comparative amounts for the prior period(s) presented in which the error occurred, or, if the error occurred before the earliest prior period presented, by restating the opening balances of assets, liabilities and equity for that earliest prior period).

Present separately major classes of gross cash receipts and gross cash payments arising from investing and financing activities (net presentation only where permitted by paragraphs 7.10A–7.10E). Present separately, classified as investing activities, the aggregate cash flows from acquisitions and from disposals of subsidiaries or other business units.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (is_small_entity == false AND is_qualifying_entity == false)

requirement_text: Disclose in significant accounting policies the measurement basis (or bases) used for financial instruments and the other accounting policies used for financial instruments that are relevant to an understanding of the financial statements.

Disclose information that enables users to evaluate the significance of financial instruments for the entity's financial position and performance (e.g. for long-term debt: interest rate, maturity, repayment schedule, and restrictions imposed by the debt instrument). Where risks arising from financial instruments are particularly significant to the business (e.g. they are principal risks), additional disclosure may be required (see also paragraphs 34.19–34.30 for relevant examples).
trigger_condition: has_financial_instruments_at_fair_value OR has_finance_lease_assets OR has_issued_financial_guarantee_contracts OR has_transferred_financial_assets_not_derecognised OR has_unremedied_loan_breach_or_default OR has_offset_financial_assets_and_liabilities OR has_non_trading_non_derivative_section12_instruments

requirement_text: Disclose information that enables users of the financial statements to evaluate the significance of financial instruments for the entity's financial position and performance (e.g. for long-term debt, the terms and conditions such as interest rate, maturity, repayment schedule and restrictions imposed).
Disclose that the practical expedient in paragraph 11.20C has been applied. Also consider whether any further disclosure is necessary, for example in accordance with paragraphs 8.6 and 8.7.

Where risks arising from financial instruments are particularly significant to the business (e.g. they are principal risks for the entity), consider whether additional disclosure is required, drawing on the examples in paragraphs 34.19–34.30 where relevant.

Disclose the fact that a reliable measure of fair value is no longer available, and the carrying amount of those financial instruments that would otherwise be required to be measured at fair value through profit or loss.

For each class of financial assets transferred to another party in a transaction that does not qualify for derecognition (under paragraphs 11.33–11.35), disclose the required information specified in paragraph 11.45 sub-paragraphs for each such class

For each loan payable recognised at the reporting date where there has been a breach of terms or default of principal, interest, sinking fund, or redemption terms that has not been remedied by the reporting date, disclose details of that breach or default (as required by the sub-paragraphs of this paragraph).
A financial institution shall, in addition, apply the requirements of paragraph 34.17.

Disclose the nature and extent of risks arising from financial instruments subject to interest rate benchmark reform, how the entity manages those risks, and the entity's progress in completing the transition from interest rate benchmarks to alternative benchmark rates.
Make all disclosures required by Section 11, incorporating financial instruments within the scope of Section 12 as well as those within the scope of Section 11.
For Section 12 financial instruments that are not held as part of a trading portfolio and are not derivative instruments, make the additional disclosures required by paragraph 11.48A.
If hedge accounting is used, make the additional disclosures required by paragraphs 12.27 to 12.29A.

For financial instruments in the scope of Section 12 that are not held as part of a trading portfolio and are not derivative instruments, provide the additional disclosures set out in paragraph 11.48A.
Present cash flows arising from income tax separately and classify them as operating activities unless they can be specifically identified with financing or investing activities.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (is_small_entity == false AND is_qualifying_entity == false)

requirement_text: Disclose separately for each type of hedging relationship described in paragraph 12.19: (a) a description of each hedge; (b) a description of the financial instruments designated as hedging instruments and their fair values at the reporting date; (c) the nature of the risks being hedged, including a description of the hedged item; and any other items enumerated in paragraph 12.27 for that hedge type.
Disclose the periods when the hedged cash flows are expected to occur and when they are expected to affect profit or loss

Disclose all information required by paragraph 12.29 in respect of each cash flow hedge, including: a description of the hedging instrument; a description of the hedged item or transaction; the nature of the risks being hedged; and the periods when the hedged cash flows are expected to occur and affect profit or loss
Disclose the information required by paragraph 12.29 for each cash flow hedge (including the nature of the risks being hedged and other specified items listed in 12.29)
Disclose the information required by paragraph 12.29 in respect of any cash flow hedge (full sub-items not verifiable from the truncated paragraph text supplied)
Disclose the amount reclassified from equity into profit or loss during the period in respect of the cash flow hedge

Disclose separately the amounts recognised in other comprehensive income and the amounts recognised in profit or loss arising from hedge accounting for a net investment in a foreign operation (per paragraphs 12.24(a) and 12.24(b) respectively).

When the entity has taken advantage of the temporary amendments to specific hedge accounting requirements in paragraphs 12.25C to 12.25F, disclose the information required by paragraph 12.30 (the specific disclosures listed thereunder relating to those temporary IBOR-reform hedge accounting amendments).
Disclose the fair value of investments in associates accounted for using the equity method for which there are published price quotations
Present income tax cash flows separately in the cash flow statement and classify them as operating activities unless they can be specifically identified with financing or investing activities.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (is_small_entity == false AND is_qualifying_entity == false)

requirement_text: Disclose the reasons why the presumption that an investor does not have significant influence is overcome, where the investor holds less than 20% of the voting power but concludes it does have significant influence

Disclose the reasons why the presumption that an investor does have significant influence is overcome, where the investor holds 20% or more of the voting power but concludes it does not have significant influence

Disclose the reasons why the presumption that an investor does have significant influence is rebutted, where the investor holds 20% or more of the voting power but concludes it does not have significant influence
Disclose the amount of dividends and other distributions recognised as income from investments in associates accounted for using the cost model.

Disclose separately the investor's share of the profit or loss of associates accounted for using the equity method, and separately the investor's share of any discontinued operations of such associates.
Disclose separately the investor's share of the profit or loss of associates accounted for using the equity method.

Present cash flows arising from income tax separately in the cash flow statement and classify them as cash flows from operating activities unless they can be specifically identified with financing or investing activities.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (is_small_entity == false AND is_qualifying_entity == false)

requirement_text: For investments in associates accounted for in accordance with paragraph 14.4(c), disclose the information required by paragraphs 11.43 and 11.44 (financial instrument disclosures).

In the individual financial statements of an investor that is not a parent, disclose summarised financial information about investments in associates together with the effect of including those investments as if accounted for using the equity method.
trigger_condition: is_individual_financial_statements == true AND has_investments_in_associates == true AND is_parent_entity == false AND uses_consolidation_exemption == false AND would_be_exempt_from_consolidation_if_had_subsidiaries == false

requirement_text: Disclose separately the venturer's share of the profit or loss of jointly controlled entities accounted for under the equity method, and separately its share of any discontinued operations of such jointly controlled entities.

Disclose separately (a) the venturer's share of the profit or loss of jointly controlled entities accounted for under the equity method, and (b) its share of any discontinued operations of such jointly controlled entities.

Disclose the carrying amount at the end of the reporting period of investment property rented to another group entity where the entity has chosen (elected under paragraph 16.4A) to account for such properties using the cost model in accordance with Section 17.
For jointly controlled entities accounted for in accordance with paragraph 15.9(c), disclose the information required by paragraphs 11.43 and 11.44.

The individual financial statements of a venturer that is not a parent shall disclose summarised financial information about investments in jointly controlled entities, together with the effect of including those investments as if accounted for using the equity method.
trigger_condition: has_interests_in_jointly_controlled_entities == true and is_individual_financial_statements == true and is_parent_entity == false and uses_consolidation_exemption == false

requirement_text: In accordance with Section 20, provide all disclosures required by Section 20 in respect of leases into which the entity has entered (whether as lessee or lessor).

The Section 17 cost-model disclosures (other than those related to fair value measurement) are relevant to and should be applied to investment properties rented to another group entity that are measured under the cost model pursuant to paragraph 16.4A(b). See the individual Section 17 disclosure rows for the specific requirements.

Disclose for each class of property, plant and equipment the measurement bases used for determining the gross carrying amount, the depreciation methods used, and the useful lives or the depreciation rates used (paragraphs 17.31(a)–(c)).

Present the components of cash and cash equivalents; and present a reconciliation of the amounts in the statement of cash flows to the equivalent items in the statement of financial position, unless the cash and cash equivalents amount in the statement of cash flows is identical to the amount similarly described in the statement of financial position.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (is_small_entity == false AND is_qualifying_entity == false)

requirement_text: When items of property, plant and equipment are stated at revalued amounts, disclose the information required by paragraph 17.32A (sub-paragraphs (a) onwards); this row records the trigger condition — individual sub-paragraph rows should be reviewed against the specific lettered requirements of 17.32A.

Disclose, for each class of intangible assets, the information required by paragraph 18.27 (useful life or amortisation rate and the basis for estimating useful life; amortisation method; gross carrying amount and accumulated amortisation at start and end of period; line items in income statement where amortisation is included; reconciliation of carrying amount at start and end of period showing additions, disposals, amortisation, impairment, and other movements).

Disclose the nature of intangible assets the acquirer chooses to recognise separately from goodwill in a business combination that meet condition (a) and only one of (b) or (c) in paragraph 18.8, and the reason why they have been separated from goodwill.

Disclose the aggregate amount of research and development expenditure recognised as an expense during the period (i.e. internally incurred R&D not capitalised as an intangible asset or as part of another qualifying asset).
Disclose the effective date of the revaluation of intangible assets carried at revalued amounts

Where intangible assets are accounted for at revalued amounts, disclose all items required by paragraph 18.29A (which lists specific items including, as applicable: the effective date of the revaluation; whether an independent valuer was involved; the methods and significant assumptions applied in estimating the assets' fair values; the carrying amount that would have been recognised had the assets been carried under the cost model; and the revaluation surplus).

If intangible assets are accounted for at revalued amounts, disclose the information required by paragraph 18.29A (the specific sub-items of which are not reproduced in the verbatim text supplied — reviewer must verify disclosures against the full paragraph including all lettered sub-items).

After the acquisition date, include the acquiree's income and expenses in the acquirer's statement of comprehensive income based on the cost of the business combination to the acquirer (e.g. depreciation on the acquiree's depreciable assets must be based on their fair values at the acquisition date, not their pre-acquisition carrying amounts).

For each business combination (excluding group reconstructions) effected during the period, disclose the specified information required by paragraph 19.25 (e.g. name and description of acquiree, acquisition date, percentage of voting equity acquired, cost of combination, amounts recognised for each class of assets and liabilities, goodwill recognised, etc.).

Disclose, separately for each material business combination occurring during the reporting period, the amounts of revenue and profit or loss of the acquiree since the acquisition date that are included in the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for the reporting period. For business combinations that individually are not material, this information may be provided in aggregate rather than separately.

Disclose a reconciliation of the carrying amount of the excess recognised in accordance with paragraph 19.24 at the beginning and end of the reporting period, showing separately each of the items enumerated in the sub-paragraphs of 19.26A (e.g. additions, amounts recognised in profit or loss, and any other movements).

For a combination accounted for under Section 19 merger accounting, bring the results and cash flows of all combining entities into the financial statements from the beginning of the financial year in which the combination occurred, adjusted to achieve uniformity of accounting policies. Restate comparative information to include the total comprehensive income of all combining entities for the previous reporting period and their statement of financial position for the previous reporting date, adjusted to achieve uniformity of accounting policies.

Results and cash flows of all combining entities shall be brought into the financial statements of the combined entity from the beginning of the financial year in which the combination occurred, adjusted to achieve uniformity of accounting policies.

Restate comparative information to include the total comprehensive income for all combining entities for the previous reporting period and their statement of financial position for the previous reporting date, adjusted as necessary to achieve uniformity of accounting policies.

Show (i) the difference between the nominal value of shares issued plus fair value of any other consideration given and the nominal value of shares received in exchange as a movement on other reserves in the consolidated financial statements; (ii) any existing balances on the share premium account or capital redemption reserve of the new subsidiary brought in as a movement on other reserves; and (iii) all such movements in the statement of changes in equity.

(1) Show the difference between the nominal value of shares issued plus the fair value of any other consideration given, and the nominal value of shares received in exchange, as a movement on other reserves in the consolidated financial statements. (2) Bring in any existing balances on the share premium account or capital redemption reserve of the new subsidiary as a movement on other reserves in the consolidated financial statements. (3) Show all such movements in the statement of changes in equity.

Show in the statement of changes in equity: (a) the difference (if any) between the nominal value of shares issued plus the fair value of any other consideration given, and the nominal value of shares received in exchange, as a movement on other reserves; and (b) any existing share premium account or capital redemption reserve balances of the new subsidiary brought in, as a movement on other reserves.

For each group reconstruction effected during the period, disclose the information required by paragraph 19.33 (comprising the enumerated sub-paragraph items specified therein, such as names of combining entities, date of reconstruction, method of accounting, etc.).
Present a complete set of financial statements comprising all components required for a small entity under Section 1A (the specific components being those enumerated in paragraphs 1A.8(a)–(e))
Present comparative information for the preceding period for all amounts presented in the current period's financial statements, except where FRS 102 permits or requires otherwise.
A small entity that chooses to use titles for its financial statements other than those used in FRS 102 may do so only provided those titles are not misleading.
Present the components of cash and cash equivalents.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (is_small_entity == false AND is_qualifying_entity == false)

requirement_text: Present separately major classes of gross cash receipts and gross cash payments arising from investing and financing activities (net presentation only where permitted by paragraphs 7.10A–7.10E). Aggregate cash flows from acquisitions and disposals of subsidiaries or other business units must be presented separately and classified as investing activities.

Present separately in the cash flow statement cash flows from interest received, interest paid, dividends received, and dividends paid; and classify each of these cash flows consistently from period to period as operating, investing or financing activities.
trigger_condition: presents_cash_flow_statement == true AND (NOT is_qualifying_entity OR NOT uses_consolidation_exemption)

requirement_text: Present sufficient information in the notes to the financial statements to give a true and fair view of the assets, liabilities, financial position and profit or loss of the small entity for the reporting period.

Present separately cash flows from interest and dividends received and paid in the cash flow statement; and classify these cash flows consistently from period to period as operating, investing, or financing activities.

Classify interest paid as either an operating cash flow or a financing cash flow, and classify interest received and dividends received as either operating cash flows or investing cash flows, using one of the two permitted bases described in paragraph 7.15.

Consider making the encouraged disclosures set out in Appendix E to Section 1A; note that these disclosures may nevertheless be necessary in order to give a true and fair view and satisfy the requirements of paragraph 1A.5, in which case they become effectively mandatory.
If a small parent entity voluntarily prepares consolidated financial statements, it must comply with the requirements of Section 9 in preparing those statements

A small entity that elects to apply paragraph 1B(1) of Schedule 1 to the Small Companies Regulations and adapt a balance sheet format must, as a minimum, include in its statement of financial position line items that present the items enumerated in paragraph 1AA.3, distinguishing between those that are current and those that are non-current
Present current assets and non-current assets, and current liabilities and non-current liabilities, as separate classifications in the statement of financial position.
Present current assets and non-current assets, and current liabilities and non-current liabilities, as separate classifications in the statement of financial position.
A complete set of financial statements shall include a statement of financial position as at the reporting date.
A complete set of financial statements shall include a statement of comprehensive income or an income statement and a statement of other comprehensive income for the reporting period.
A complete set of financial statements shall include notes comprising a summary of significant accounting policies and other explanatory information.
Present each financial statement within a complete set of financial statements with equal prominence.

Present in the statement of changes in equity: the effects of changes in accounting policies and corrections of material errors recognised in the period (this row covers one sub-element of paragraph 6.2; companion rows should address profit or loss, OCI, and investments/dividends/distributions)
trigger_condition: (has_accounting_policy_changes == true OR has_material_prior_period_error == true) AND presents_statement_of_changes_in_equity == false

requirement_text: Present in the statement of changes in equity: (1) profit or loss for the reporting period; (2) other comprehensive income for the period; (3) effects of changes in accounting policies and corrections of material errors recognised in the period; and (4) amounts of investments by, and dividends and other distributions to, equity investors during the period

A small entity applying the abridged profit and loss account (paragraph 1A(2) of Schedule 1 to the Small Companies Regulations) must still ensure the financial statements give a true and fair view, and must consider whether additional note disclosures are necessary (e.g. disaggregating gross profit or loss, disclosing turnover) by reference to paragraph 1A.16.
trigger_condition: applies_section_1A == true AND (applies_paragraph_1A1_adapted_balance_sheet_format == false AND applies_abridged_profit_and_loss_account == true)

requirement_text: Present in the statement of changes in equity: profit or loss for the reporting period

A small entity that adds line items, amends descriptions (from those in paragraph 1AB.3), or reorders items in the income statement must ensure the information given is at least equivalent to that required by the unadapted profit and loss account format.
Present in the statement of changes in equity: other comprehensive income for the period
Present in the statement of changes in equity: the effects of changes in accounting policies and corrections of material errors recognised in the period
Present in the statement of changes in equity: amounts of investments by, and dividends and other distributions to, equity investors during the period

Present in the statement of changes in equity: (i) profit or loss for the period; (ii) other comprehensive income for the period; (iii) effects of changes in accounting policies and corrections of material errors recognised in the period; and (iv) amounts of investments by, and dividends and other distributions to, equity investors during the period.

Where the small entity is a subsidiary, information must be given in respect of the parent of the smallest group for which consolidated financial statements are drawn up of which the small entity is a member (as specified in paragraph 1AC.34 and its sub-paragraphs).
trigger_condition: applies_section_1A == true AND (is_qualifying_entity == true AND is_part_of_group == true)

requirement_text: A lessee with finance leases shall disclose in the notes: (a) the net carrying amount at the reporting date for each class of asset held under finance leases; (b) a reconciliation between the total of future minimum lease payments at the reporting date and their present value, together with the total of future minimum lease payments at the reporting date and their present value for each of: not later than one year, later than one year and not later than five years, and later than five years; (c) contingent rents recognised as an expense in the period; (d) the total of future minimum sublease payments expected to be received under non-cancellable subleases at the reporting date; and (e) a general description of the lessee's material leasing arrangements including, for example, information about contingent rent, renewal or purchase options and escalation clauses, subleases, and restrictions imposed by lease arrangements.

Disclose information about leased assets held under finance leases in accordance with the requirements of Section 17 (Property, Plant and Equipment), Section 18 (Intangible Assets) and Section 27 (Impairment of Assets) as applicable to those assets.
Disclose the required information for operating leases (details specified in sub-paragraphs of 20.16)
Disclose the required information for finance leases as a lessor (paragraph 20.23 sets out the specific items to be disclosed).
A lessor shall present assets subject to operating leases in the statement of financial position according to the nature of the asset.

As a lessor under operating leases, disclose: (a) future minimum lease payments under non-cancellable operating leases in aggregate and analysed by: within one year, between one and five years, and after five years; (b) total contingent rents recognised as income in the period; and (c) a general description of significant leasing arrangements including, for example, information about contingent rent, renewal or purchase options, and escalation clauses.
Apply the disclosure requirements for assets under Sections 17, 18 and 27 to assets provided under operating leases.

For sale and leaseback transactions, apply all lessee and lessor disclosure requirements that would otherwise apply to the resulting lease, including description of any unique or unusual provisions of the sale and leaseback agreement or terms.
Disclose the nature and business purpose of financial guarantee contracts issued.

For each class of provision, disclose the following (the paragraph head; sub-items are listed in the full 21.14 text and include: the carrying amount at the beginning and end of the period; additional provisions made in the period, including increases to existing provisions; amounts used during the period; unused amounts reversed during the period; and the unwinding of any discount or change in the discount rate).

Disclose (a) a description of the nature of any contingent assets at the end of the reporting period where an inflow of economic benefits is probable but not virtually certain, and (b) when practicable, an estimate of their financial effect measured using the principles in paragraphs 21.7–21.11; if it is impracticable to make such an estimate, state that fact.

Disclose a description of the nature of contingent assets where an inflow of economic benefits is probable but not virtually certain; and, where practicable, an estimate of their financial effect measured using the principles in paragraphs 21.7 to 21.11. If it is impracticable to disclose the financial effect estimate, state that fact.
Disclose the nature and business purpose of financial guarantee contracts issued by the entity.
Where applicable, also provide the disclosures required by paragraphs 21.14 and 21.15 in respect of financial guarantee contracts issued.
Provide the disclosures required by paragraphs 21.14 and 21.15 in relation to financial guarantee contracts issued, where those paragraphs are applicable.

Disclose the fair value of any non-cash assets distributed to owners during the reporting period, unless the non-cash assets are ultimately controlled by the same parties both before and after the distribution.

Disclose the gross amount due from customers for contract work as the net amount of costs incurred plus recognised profits less the sum of recognised losses and progress billings, where this amount is positive (i.e. an asset)

Present costs incurred less costs recognised as contract expenses as contract work in progress within inventories on the statement of financial position, unless the entity has adapted its balance sheet format under paragraph 4.2A.

Disclose the accounting policy adopted for borrowing costs capitalisation and the specific items required by paragraph 25.3A (including the amount of borrowing costs capitalised during the period and the capitalisation rate used)
Disclose information about the nature and extent of share-based payment arrangements that existed during the period, including all specific items enumerated in the sub-paragraphs of paragraph 26.18.

Disclose information about how the fair value of goods or services received, or the value of equity instruments granted, was measured for equity-settled share-based payment arrangements. Where a valuation methodology was used, also disclose the method and the reason for choosing it.
For equity-settled share-based payment arrangements, disclose how the fair value of goods or services received, or the value of equity instruments granted, was measured.

Where a valuation methodology was used to measure the value of equity instruments granted under an equity-settled share-based payment arrangement, disclose the method used and the reason for choosing it.
Disclose information about how the liability was measured for cash-settled share-based payment arrangements.
Disclose an explanation of modifications to share-based payment arrangements that were modified during the period.
Disclose that the share-based payment expense is measured on the basis of a reasonable allocation of the group expense, and disclose the basis for that allocation.
trigger_condition: has_share_based_payment_arrangements == true and is_part_of_group_sbp_arrangement == true and uses_reasonable_allocation_for_group_sbp == true

requirement_text: Disclose the following specific information (as enumerated in paragraph 26.23 sub-paragraphs) about the effect of share-based payment transactions on the entity's profit or loss for the period and on its financial position

Disclose the required information (as enumerated in paragraph 27.32's sub-paragraphs) for each class of asset in scope under paragraph 27.33 where an impairment loss has been recognised or reversed during the period
Disclose the impairment information required by paragraph 27.32 separately for each class of asset listed in paragraph 27.33 (do not aggregate disclosures across different asset classes).
Disclose a description of the events and circumstances that led to the recognition or reversal of an impairment loss.
Disclose the amount recognised in profit or loss as an expense for defined contribution plans.

Disclose the required information about defined benefit plans (the disclosures in paragraph 28.41 sub-items), either in aggregate, separately for each plan, or in such groupings as are considered most useful; multi-employer defined benefit plans accounted for as defined contribution plans under paragraphs 28.11/28.11A are excluded from this paragraph's disclosures (the disclosures in paragraphs 28.40 and 28.40A apply to those plans instead).
Disclose the information required by paragraph 28.41A when participating in a defined benefit plan that shares risks between entities under common control (as described in paragraph 28.38).
For each category of other long-term employee benefits provided, disclose the nature of the benefit, the amount of the obligation, and the extent of funding at the reporting date.
For each category of termination benefits provided, disclose the nature of the benefit, the accounting policy applied, the amount of the obligation, and the extent of funding at the reporting date.

Disclose information about contingent liabilities arising from uncertainty over the number of employees who will accept an offer of termination benefits, unless the possibility of an outflow in settlement is remote.
Irrecoverable VAT allocable to fixed assets and to other items disclosed separately in the financial statements shall be included in their cost where practicable and material.
Turnover shown in profit or loss shall exclude VAT and other similar sales taxes on taxable outputs and VAT imputed under the flat rate VAT scheme.
Expenses shown in profit or loss shall exclude recoverable VAT and other similar recoverable sales taxes.
Irrecoverable VAT allocable to fixed assets and to other items disclosed separately in the financial statements shall be included in their cost where practicable and material.
Irrecoverable VAT allocable to fixed assets and to other items disclosed separately in the financial statements shall be included in their cost where practicable and material.
Irrecoverable VAT allocable to fixed assets and to other items disclosed separately in the financial statements shall be included in their cost where practicable and material.
Present deferred tax liabilities within 'provisions for liabilities' and deferred tax assets within 'debtors' on the face of the statement of financial position.
trigger_condition: (has_deferred_tax_asset == true OR has_deferred_tax_liability == true) AND applies_paragraph_1A1_adapted_balance_sheet_format == false

requirement_text: Disclose information enabling users to evaluate the nature and financial effect of the current and deferred tax consequences of recognised transactions and other events.
Disclose separately the major components of tax expense (income).

Disclose the components of income tax expense (income) separately. The paragraph introduces a list of specific components to be disclosed separately (e.g. current tax expense/income, deferred tax expense/income, adjustments in respect of prior periods, and any other components enumerated in paragraph 29.27); each component must be presented as a separate disclosure rather than as an aggregate figure.
Where the presentation currency differs from the functional currency, state that fact, disclose the functional currency, and explain the reason for using a different presentation currency.
When the presentation currency differs from the functional currency, translate all items of income and expense and financial position into the presentation currency.

Translate results and financial position into the presentation currency using the procedures required by FRS 102 paragraph 30.18, where the functional currency is not that of a hyperinflationary economy.

An intragroup monetary asset (or liability) with a foreign operation cannot be eliminated against the corresponding intragroup liability (or asset) without showing the results of currency fluctuations; in the consolidated financial statements the entity must continue to recognise the resulting exchange difference in profit or loss or, if it arises from the circumstances described in paragraph 30.13, in other comprehensive income.
trigger_condition: prepares_consolidated_financial_statements == true and has_foreign_operation == true and has_intragroup_monetary_items_in_foreign_currency == true

requirement_text: Disclose the currency in which the financial statements are presented.
Disclose the fact of and reason for any change in the functional currency of the reporting entity or a significant foreign operation.
State all amounts in the financial statements in terms of the measuring unit current at the end of the reporting period.
State comparative information for the previous period, and any information presented in respect of earlier periods, in terms of the measuring unit current at the end of the reporting period.

Index-linked or otherwise price-linked assets and liabilities shall be adjusted in accordance with their linking agreement and presented at the resulting adjusted amount in the restated statement of financial position (i.e. the hyperinflationary-restated balance sheet).

At the end of the first period of hyperinflationary reporting and in subsequent periods, restate all components of owners' equity by applying a general price index from the beginning of the period, or from the date of contribution if later, in financial statements prepared under Section 31 (Hyperinflation).

Disclose the changes for the period in owners' equity in accordance with Section 6 (Statement of Changes in Equity and Statement of Income and Retained Earnings) in hyperinflationary functional currency financial statements prepared under Section 31.

Where there has been a post-period deterioration in operating results or financial position, consider whether the going concern assumption remains appropriate; if it no longer is, apply the disclosure requirements of paragraph 3.9 (fundamental change in basis of accounting) rather than merely adjusting amounts within the original basis.

Include in the financial statements the disclosures necessary to draw attention to the possibility that the entity's financial position and profit or loss have been affected by the existence of related parties and by transactions and outstanding balances with such parties.

Disclose the information required by paragraph 33.9 separately for each of the following categories of related party: (a) entities with control, joint control or significant influence over the entity; (b) subsidiaries; (c) associates; (d) joint ventures in which the entity is a venturer; (e) key management personnel; (f) other related parties.

For each class of biological asset measured using the fair value model, disclose the required information per paragraph 34.7 (sub-items to be checked individually against the standard, covering: description of each class; methods and significant assumptions applied in determining fair value less costs to sell; fair value less costs to sell at beginning and end of period; reconciliation of changes in carrying amount including purchases, sales, harvesting, and gains/losses from fair value changes; and physical quantities of production or changes in the period).
Disclose why fair value cannot be reliably measured for any individual biological asset measured at cost under paragraph 34.6A.
Where any biological asset is measured at cost under paragraph 34.6A, disclose why fair value cannot be reliably measured.

Where the fair value of a biological asset previously measured at cost becomes reliably measurable during the current period, disclose why fair value has become reliably measurable and the effect of the change.
Disclose the methods and significant assumptions applied in determining the fair value at the point of harvest of each class of agricultural produce.

For each class of biological asset measured using the cost model, disclose the required information specified under paragraph 34.10 (sub-items (a) onwards, covering matters such as depreciation method, useful lives or depreciation rates used, gross carrying amount and accumulated depreciation at the beginning and end of the period, and a reconciliation of the carrying amount).
Disclose the methods and significant assumptions applied in determining the fair value at the point of harvest of agricultural produce measured at fair value less costs to sell.
Disclose that it is not practical to apply a particular requirement of paragraph 18 of IFRS 6 to previous comparative amounts on first-time adoption of this FRS.

Disclose information enabling users to evaluate the nature and extent of risks arising from service concession arrangements, typically including: a description of the arrangement; any rights, obligations or options arising; and significant terms that may affect the amount, timing and certainty of future cash flows.
Disclose the amount of revenue, profits or losses and other income recognised in the period on exchanging construction services for a financial asset or an intangible asset.
A financial institution shall provide the additional disclosures in paragraphs 34.19 to 34.33, in addition to the disclosure requirements in Section 11 and Section 12.
Disclose information that enables users to evaluate the significance of financial instruments for the entity's financial position and performance.

Disclose a disaggregation of each statement of financial position line item by class of financial instrument, where a class is a grouping appropriate to the nature of the information and the characteristics of those financial instruments.
Disclose a reconciliation of changes in the separate allowance account during the period for each class of financial asset.
trigger_condition: is_financial_institution == true and uses_separate_allowance_account_for_impairment == true and applies_ifrs9_recognition_and_measurement == false

requirement_text: Disclose information that enables users to understand the effect of credit risk on the amount, timing and uncertainty of future cash flows, including each of the specific items listed in the sub-clauses of paragraph 34.21A (each of which is individually mandatory), when the entity is a financial institution that has made the accounting policy choice under both paragraphs 11.2(c) and 12.2(c) to apply the recognition and measurement provisions of IFRS 9.

For each class of financial instrument held at fair value in the statement of financial position, disclose an analysis of the level in the fair value hierarchy into which the fair value measurements are categorised, based on the lowest level input that is significant to the measurement in its entirety.

Disclose information enabling users to evaluate the nature and extent of credit risk, liquidity risk and market risk arising from financial instruments to which the entity is exposed at the end of the reporting period.

Disclose information enabling users to evaluate the nature and extent of credit risk, liquidity risk and market risk arising from financial instruments to which the entity is exposed at the end of the reporting period.

Disclose information enabling users to evaluate the nature and extent of credit risk, liquidity risk and market risk arising from financial instruments to which the entity is exposed at the end of the reporting period.
For each type of risk arising from financial instruments, a financial institution shall disclose the required risk disclosures (as specified in the remainder of paragraph 34.24 sub-clauses).

A financial institution shall disclose, by class of financial instrument, the information required under paragraph 34.25 for financial instruments within the scope of Section 11 or Section 12 to which the impairment requirements of IFRS 9 are not applied

Disclose, by class of financial asset, the analysis required by paragraph 34.26 of FRS 102 (which specifies items such as credit-quality analysis, carrying amounts of financial assets that are past due or impaired, and related collateral and credit enhancements). This disclosure is required unless the entity has made the accounting policy choice under both paragraphs 11.2(c) and 12.2(c) to apply the recognition and measurement provisions of IFRS 9.

When a financial institution obtains financial or non-financial assets during the period by taking possession of collateral or calling on other credit enhancements (e.g. guarantees), and such assets meet the recognition criteria in other sections, the financial institution shall make the disclosures required by paragraph 34.27 (and its sub-paragraphs). This row captures the gating condition; the specific items to be disclosed are set out in the sub-paragraphs that follow §34.27.
trigger_condition: is_financial_institution == true AND has_assets_obtained_via_collateral_or_credit_enhancement == true AND assets_obtained_meet_recognition_criteria == true

requirement_text: Disclose a maturity analysis for financial liabilities showing remaining contractual maturities at undiscounted amounts, separated between derivative and non-derivative financial liabilities.

Disclose a sensitivity analysis for each type of market risk (e.g. interest rate risk, currency risk, other price risk) to which the entity is exposed, showing the impact on profit or loss and equity; and disclose details of the methods and assumptions used in preparing the sensitivity analysis.
Provide a sensitivity analysis for each type of market risk (e.g. interest rate risk, currency risk, other price risk) to which the entity is exposed, showing the impact on profit or loss and equity.
Disclose information enabling users to evaluate the entity's objectives, policies and processes for managing capital.

Where an aggregate disclosure of capital requirements and how capital is managed would not provide useful information or would distort a financial statement user's understanding of capital resources, disclose separate information for each capital requirement to which the entity is subject.
A retirement benefit plan applying FRS 102 shall also apply the requirements of paragraphs 34.35 to 34.48.
Where a retirement benefit plan has both defined benefit and defined contribution elements, the financial statements shall distinguish between those elements where material.
An entity that is a retirement benefit plan shall apply the requirements of paragraphs 34.35 to 34.48.

The financial statements of a retirement benefit plan shall contain, as part of the financial statements, the items enumerated in paragraph 34.35 (a)–(d) (such as a statement of net assets available for benefits, actuarial present value of promised retirement benefits, etc.) rather than complying with paragraph 3.17.

Where a retirement benefit plan holds assets other than financial instruments at fair value, apply and provide the disclosures required by the relevant section of FRS 102 for each such asset class (e.g. investment property disclosures per paragraph 16.10).

Disclose a disaggregation of the statement of net assets available for benefits by class of financial instrument, where a class is a grouping appropriate to the nature of the information and characteristics of the instruments.

For each class of financial instrument held at fair value in the statement of net assets available for benefits, disclose an analysis of the level in the fair value hierarchy into which the fair value measurements are categorised, categorised in their entirety on the basis of the lowest level input that is significant to the fair value measurement in its entirety.

Disclose information enabling users to evaluate the nature and extent of credit risk and market risk arising from financial instruments to which the retirement benefit plan is exposed at the end of the reporting period.

Disclose information enabling users to evaluate the nature and extent of credit risk and market risk arising from financial instruments to which the retirement benefit plan is exposed at the end of the reporting period.

For each type of credit and market risk arising from financial instruments, a retirement benefit plan shall disclose information about those risks. (Note: paragraph 34.44 is a list header; the specific sub-items required to be disclosed are set out in the sub-paragraphs that follow 34.44 and should be verified separately. The reviewer must confirm that all enumerated sub-items — such as the nature and extent of risks, concentrations of risk, and quantitative exposure data — are disclosed for each instrument type held by the plan.)

Disclose the required information about assets obtained by a retirement benefit plan during the period by taking possession of collateral held as security or by calling on other credit enhancements (e.g. guarantees), where such assets meet the recognition criteria in other sections — note: paragraph 34.46 ends with a colon introducing specific sub-disclosures; reviewers must consult the full standard text for the enumerated items (e.g. 34.46(a), 34.46(b)) and ensure all are captured

A defined benefit plan shall disclose, in a report alongside the financial statements, information regarding the actuarial present value of promised retirement benefits (including all sub-items specified in paragraph 34.48).
Do not exclude a subsidiary from consolidation solely because its business activities are dissimilar to those of other entities within the group.
Heritage assets shall be recognised in the statement of financial position separately from other assets (i.e. presented as a distinct line item, not aggregated with other asset classes).
Where heritage assets are held, the entity must provide all disclosures required by paragraph 34.55 for those assets.

Where it is impracticable to provide the paragraph 34.55(f) disclosures for any accounting period earlier than the previous comparable period, a statement must be made to the effect that it is impracticable to do so.
Disclose an explanation of how the transition from the previous financial reporting framework to FRS 102 affected reported financial position and financial performance.

An entity that applied FRS 102 in a previous reporting period but not in its most recent annual financial statements (a first-time re-adopter, per paragraph 35.2) shall make the disclosures required by paragraph 35.12A.

The first financial statements prepared using FRS 102 must include all items specified in paragraph 35.13 to comply with the transition requirements of paragraph 35.12 (comprising the specific reconciliations and explanations mandated by that paragraph for first-time adopters).
